About OpenSesame
OpenSesame is the trusted partner for Workforce Reinvention in the age of AI. OpenSesame delivers integrated software, curated and customizable content, and expert services – embedded into existing learning, HR, and work systems – to help organizations expand their human+AI potential and thrive through change.
Learn more: www.opensesame.com/about
Internship Overview
OpenSesame seeks passionate, driven students and new graduates who already use AI to build and solve problems to join our paid summer internship program. You’ll gain hands-on experience at a fast-growing, remote-first B2B SaaS company developing AI-powered products that help organizations upskill their people and fuel long-term growth.
As an intern, you’ll collaborate with experienced teammates across the company to help shape the future of OpenSesame. You’ll work on meaningful projects that bring new ideas to life, strengthen the customer experience, and help customers achieve success.
AI is how we work here, not a side topic. You’ll have access to AI tools, including Claude, and we’ll encourage you to use them to research, prototype, analyze, and build. You’ll explore how AI and data can inform strategy, improve customer outcomes, and shape the future of learning technology, and see how human-centered design and AI innovation combine to create products with global impact.
Intern AI Hackathon
As part of your internship you will have the opportunity to participate in our first intern AI hackathon this summer. You’ll team up with interns from other departments to pitch, build with AI, and present a working product idea that improves how OpenSesame works or serves customers.
About the Team
At OpenSesame, our Engineering Team is the creative force behind the cutting-edge solutions that bring our mission to life. Guided by Extreme Programming (XP) principles, we thrive on collaboration, pair programming, and iterative development to deliver reliable, scalable, and impactful technologies.
Our engineers—spanning software development, DevOps, and data operations—partner across teams to tackle real-world challenges, designing and building tools that adapt to the ever-changing needs of our customers. We’re an AI-forward team, integrating artificial intelligence and automation into our products and internal systems to improve efficiency, insight, and scalability.
Whether developing new product features, enhancing our infrastructure, or leveraging AI to optimize workflows, we’re fueled by a passion for innovation and a culture of continuous learning. Together, we’re redefining what’s possible in eLearning technology!
Performance Objectives
By 2 Weeks
Pair program with team members to gain hands-on experience and learn our engineering, DevOps, and deployment practices.
Participate in team discussions about tools, technologies, and AI-driven innovations while contributing to brainstorming sessions.
Begin learning the technologies we use—such as TypeScript, React, Terraform, AWS, and CI/CD systems—through direct collaboration with engineers across software and DevOps.
By 30 Days
Work on individual and team projects, contributing to production-ready code, infrastructure, or automation tools that may include AI-powered solutions.
Actively participate in all team meetings and events to understand how different engineering disciplines collaborate to deliver intelligent, data-driven solutions.
Suggest improvements to processes, workflows, or AI-enabled tools based on your early observations and experiences.
By 60 Days
Take ownership of individual tasks and contribute independently to ongoing engineering, DevOps, or AI-related projects.
Support efforts to enhance system reliability, scalability, and automation through the integration of AI and modern engineering practices.
Share insights and knowledge about emerging technologies—especially in AI, automation, and infrastructure—helping foster team learning and continuous improvement.
Application and Creative Project
Before you start, check out our Creative Project guide . It walks through what we're looking for below in more detail.
To apply, submit one application, which includes a link to your creative project. We want to see how you think and what you've built, so your creative project must be a video (5 minutes or less), shared as a YouTube link (unlisted is fine). Applications without a working YouTube link will not be reviewed.
We care more about your curiosity and how you think than a polished result, so don't let your experience level stop you from applying.
You can talk to the camera, or walk us through slides, a demo, or a screen recording. How you show it is up to you. In your video, please cover:
How do you see OpenSesame fitting into your career journey or long-term goals?
What strengths, skills, or perspectives do you bring to OpenSesame to make an impact and contribute to our mission?
Show us something you've built with AI. What problem did you solve, and what excites you about where AI is taking learning and work?
Haven't built anything with AI yet? Make something today! Try an AI tool, experiment with a new idea, and show us or walk us through how you did it.
Feel free to share something from your personal life, work, school, or anywhere else. Share whatever feels right to you.
We're drawn to curiosity, creativity, growth mindset and authentic expression. Keep it concise and focused.
Not selected for this role? You're still in the running. We'll review your application for alignment with our other open internships. If we see a potential fit, we'll reach out to you directly.
Additional Program Details
Application closes: Sunday, February 14th, 2027
Program dates: Anticipated start June 17, 2027 through August 28th, 2027. We can adjust up to two weeks earlier for students returning to school before the program concludes.
Commitment: Full-time (40 hours/week)
Eligibility and location: Must be a current student enrolled in a college/university program or have graduated within the past 12 months (undergraduate, postgraduate, or associate programs accepted). This position is fully remote and can be based anywhere in the U.S.
Compensation: $25 an hour
Equipment: Interns must have a personal computer with specs suitable for the work and access to consistent high-speed internet during working hours.
Opportunities and expectations: OpenSesame’s internship program is immersive and growth-focused, pairing each intern with a dedicated mentor and offering meaningful, hands-on projects that make an impact. You’ll also take part in professional development sessions, networking opportunities, the intern hackathon, and book club discussions, receive volunteer time off to give back to your community, and gain full access to our course catalog for your own learning and development.
Interview process: After the application review, selected candidates will be invited to a virtual OpenSesame webinar to learn more about our company, culture, and internship program. Following the event, selected candidates will move forward to interviews with the hiring manager and team for the department they’re being considered for.
